changes: New installation-shared Cloudflare R2 workspace sync endpoint GET/PUT /api/monitor/radar/workspace with revision checks; all UI changes remain locally persistent if the Worker is unavailable.

Persist up to four floating chart symbols, geometry, z-layer sent-back state, locks, minimized flags, vertical price scale and selected Heikin-Ashi level timestamp across reloads and, after deploying the Worker, devices.
Sync user-added custom PERP symbols (max eight) through the same R2 snapshot without modifying symbols.js or the separate monitor.html watchlist.
Restore send-back chart control between Lock and Reset; only send chart below crypto sector list, never below stock sector list.
Resize terminal status footprint and expand compact footer chart taskbar; add a tile button on its right side.
Auto-tile two charts side-by-side, four in 2x2, and three in alternating top-2/bottom-1 or top-1/bottom-2 layouts on consecutive clicks; restore tile geometry using shared state.
Support narrow chart windows down to 320px and dynamic price-axis width, preserving all-visible 21 crypto and 12 stock rows.
